item.title: Dublin come back as Monaghan fall
item.description: Monaghan were left to count the cost of missed goal chances as Dublin scored a four point win in Croke Park. The Farney men created seven goal opportunities over the 70 minutes but failed to raise a green flag. Joe Quigley’s goal seven minutes from time, swung the game in favour of the Dubs as Monaghan have lost their opening three Allianz League games. item.title: Rita McPhillips née Hughes
item.description: Rita McPhillips née Hughes Rakeeragh, Monaghan and formerly of Legacurry Rita McPhillips née Hughes passed away on Saturday 14th February, peacefully at home in the loving care of her adoring family. Pre-deceased by her husband Patrick, her sister Kathleen and brother Jim. item.title: Councillor calls for traffic calming measures on two local roads
item.description: A local councillor is calling for traffic calming measures on two roads leading into Kilnaleck. Cllr Noel Connell raised the issue at the most recent sitting of the Ballyjamesduff Municipal District meeting. He called for a pedestrian crossing on the Ballinagh Rd and the Crosserlough Rd in Kilnaleck. He said the issue was raised to him by a number of local concerned residents. item.title: Cavan comfortably beaten by Tyrone in Omagh
item.description: Cavan’s long wait for a victory over Tyrone goes on, following a 12 point defeat in this afternoons meeting. The Breffni men have now gone over 40-years since last beating the red hand county. Cavan started the stronger, Oisin Brady firing over a two-pointer. However, Tiarnan Madden palmed the ball to the Tyrone net after four minutes.
